summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse allocation feature implementing atomic reservations, priority handling, idempotent order processing, and immutable input safety based on stakeholder interviews.

requirements.description: Reserve all lines of an order together atomically or reserve nothing; aggregate repeated SKU quantities prior to stock verification.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: warehouse stock inventory and an order with multiple or repeated SKU lines
acceptance.when: reservation is attempted for the order
acceptance.then: if all aggregated SKU quantities are available they are atomically subtracted from stock; otherwise no stock is deducted and insufficient_stock is returned

requirements.description: Expedited orders must be allocated inventory before normal orders, preserving input arrival order within each priority group.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: an order batch containing both expedited and normal orders
acceptance.when: orders are fulfilled against current warehouse stock
acceptance.then: all valid expedited orders are processed in arrival order before any normal orders are processed

requirements.description: Order IDs are idempotent; only the first occurrence of an identifiable ID is processed and subsequent occurrences are ignored.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: an order batch containing multiple orders with duplicate order IDs
acceptance.then: the first occurrence of each identifiable ID is evaluated and any later occurrences with the same ID are completely ignored

requirements.description: Invalid orders and invalid lines must be rejected without changing stock, and input objects must never be mutated.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: input stock and order objects that may contain invalid lines or order structures
acceptance.when: reservation or order fulfillment is executed
acceptance.then: invalid orders and invalid lines are rejected without stock deduction and without modifying any input objects

assumptions: Stock is provided as a plain object mapping nonempty string SKU keys to nonnegative safe-integer quantities.
Invalid stock objects throw a TypeError in both reserve and fulfillOrders.
A non-array orders argument passed to fulfillOrders throws a TypeError.
Order lines must be a nonempty array of objects with nonempty string sku and positive safe-integer quantity.
Aggregated SKU line quantities that exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER are rejected with invalid_lines.
Unidentifiable orders or orders with invalid/missing IDs are rejected with id null and reason invalid_order.
An identifiable first occurrence of an order with invalid priority is rejected with reason invalid_order and claims its ID.
Reservation failures do not consume stock, and invalid_order rejections are recorded in input order before reservation failures in processing order.
